title: The facade's .doc slurp is the cheaper route: routing it to the source-backed DOC reader would cost 2-5x the cycles and admit four artifacts the eager reader refuses
decision: retained, design only; survey item CORE-1 is frozen as a design record and nothing is implemented, because no value-identical routing exists
code_state: no file under crates/ was modified; git diff --name-only 8fe9efa55 -- crates/ is empty on this branch
reason_codes: route S (SourceSnapshot::open) admits four .doc fixtures that route E (the facade's eager reader) refuses with CorruptedFile("invalid stylesheet: style names and aliases must be unique"); route S never reads the stylesheet, so no ordering of the two readers can make it compute that refusal, and a source-first route would widen the facade's admitted population in violation of ADR 0006 and of GOAL's rule against trading a typed refusal for a partial result

route S's entire read surface is paragraph(Position); it has no text() or paragraph_count() primitive, so a facade Document built on it would open route E as well for seven of the DOC arm's eight queries and pay both costs

route S reads the complete artifact six times per open (identity_fingerprint is plan_same_length_stream_splices(Vec::new()), whose finish_overlay_plan_with_owner fingerprints twice for a generic ReadAt; SourceSnapshot::open takes three identity passes), against route E's single whole-file read

route S costs 2.12x to 5.07x route E's native cycles, 7.9x to 15.7x its instructions, 15x its read_at calls and 6.30x to 9.90x its p50 latency on the one query both routes answer identically, against an A/A floor of p50 <= 0.9% and p99 <= 1.9%

0587's own falsification clause for CORE-1 is satisfied in both halves: route S is not lower in instructions (it is 8-16x higher), and widening admission would require skipping a validation the eager path performs

R-B (capability dispatch, which clears the admission blocker by construction) is designed and not built: its measured benefit is a lower allocator peak on 2 of 57 fixtures at 6.3-9.9x the latency, for a single paragraph, which is speculative complexity under GOAL's decision rules

accepted_evidence.admission_census: all 57 .doc fixtures under test-data/ opened through both routes with the error kind recorded for every refusal; crosstab route E admits 42, route S admits 8, both 4, route-S-only 4, neither 11; route S refusal histogram Drawing 34, Field 4, AmbiguousTopology 4, Encrypted 3, Revision 2, Macro 1, Ole 1
accepted_evidence.value_comparison: all 57 fixtures, route E text() length and FNV-1a digest, paragraph_count(), paragraph_text(0) length and digest, against route S paragraph(0) outcome, length and digest and the concatenation of every position it serves; the two paragraph digests the record calls byte-identical are equal, no other pair of values is
accepted_evidence.read_counts: a counting ReadAt adapter records read_at calls, bytes, version() and len() calls per route-S operation: 30 calls and 6.05x-7.47x the file size on the admitted fixtures, 2.03x-2.12x on the refused ones; six complete passes account for 99.2% of picture.doc's measured bytes
accepted_evidence.syscall_counts: strace isolation pairs, 1 against 11 operations: route E 1 openat, 2 pread64 totalling file size plus 4 bytes, 11 statx; route S 1 openat, 30 pread64, 153 statx
accepted_evidence.allocator: a counting global allocator armed for one operation: route S peak is 47.9% to 83.8% lower and retained bytes 80.1% to 97.3% lower on the four fixtures both routes admit; route E retains less than the file size on the 1.62 MB fixture, correcting 0587's modelled claim that the slurped Vec is retained for the document's lifetime
accepted_evidence.instructions: callgrind isolation pairs (N and N+M, difference divided by M, --cache-sim=no): route S 3.46-5.90 M Ir per open against route E's 0.22-0.74 M on the fixtures both admit; picture.doc 460,073,873 Ir per route-S open, close to half the 912,551,293 change 0587 measured before 0589 landed
accepted_evidence.native_cycles: perf stat -r 3 isolation pairs, 200 against 1,200 operations (20 against 120 for the large fixtures): route S 342,797-435,287 cycles against route E's 67,643-205,021; route S's cost fits 217,274 + 12.90 x file_bytes over two orders of magnitude (+1.5% and +0.4% on two held-out fixtures), route E's is not proportional to bytes at all
accepted_evidence.paired_timing: Document::paragraph_text(0) against SourceSnapshot::paragraph(Position::new(0)) on the two fixtures where both routes return the identical string; 32 samples x 40 operations per leg, order A1 B1 B2 A2; route S against route E +529.9% and +890.2% at p50, route E against route S -84.1% and -89.9%
accepted_evidence.floor: A/A in the same window, two further route-E legs: p50 0.9% and 0.0%, p99 0.5% and 1.9%; the floor is below this repository's usual p50 4% / p99 14% because each sample amortizes 40 operations
accepted_evidence.fallback_penalty: the cost of a route-S open expected to be refused, measured natively with the refusal swallowed: +25.8%, +192.7% and +245.4% on top of route E's open for saved-by-table.doc, FloatingPictures.doc and ca.kwsymphony...doc; the penalty grows with file size because the wasted probe is two complete artifact passes
accepted_evidence.gates: git diff --name-only 8fe9efa55 -- crates/ empty; cargo fmt --all --check pass; probe cargo fmt --check and cargo clippy --release --all-targets pass with no warning; the one litchi dead_code warning reproduced on the untouched before checkout

accepted_costs.no_ab_pair: nothing changed, so there is no before/after leg; every figure compares two routes that both exist at the base commit
accepted_costs.callgrind_mispricing: callgrind runs SHA-256 in software and 87.95% of route S's total is sha2::sha256::soft::unroll::compress, so its instruction ratios overstate latency and are used only to rank work; every latency statement is native perf stat or wall clock
accepted_costs.warm_local_single_thread: every measurement is warm, local, single-threaded, on one host with SHA-NI; a host without it would widen route S's cycle disadvantage and a network filesystem its statx and read disadvantage, and neither was measured
accepted_costs.allocator_not_rss: peak and retained figures are counting-allocator bytes, not RSS; they exclude the page-cache copy, the stack and anything the global allocator does not see
accepted_costs.two_probe_binaries: pair A produced the profiled and timed numbers and pair B (one clippy style fix inside a subcommand no timed mode reaches) the deterministic ones; pair B reproduces every deterministic output byte-for-byte and the timing spot check within the A/A floor
accepted_costs.shared_host: eight measurement agents were active throughout; every measured process was pinned to CPU 29 and the A/A control was taken in the same window

known_gaps.corpus_ceiling: the largest .doc in the repository is 1,619,457 bytes, with no DIFAT-scale artifact and no 4,096-byte-sector CFB; route S's per-byte term means the corpus understates its disadvantage, but the fit is extrapolated beyond 1.45 MB and is labelled modelled where used
known_gaps.feature_combination: the facade was measured with features = ["doc", "docx"]; the docx-disabled arm reaches the same read_path_source_bytes slurp through DocumentSourcePathDetection::Bytes rather than DocxSourcePathDetection::Bytes, so the ingress is identical, but the ODT and OOXML probes that precede it differ and were not measured separately
known_gaps.no_prototype: R-B was designed, not prototyped; no patch exists in this packet because the capability blocker makes one premature
known_gaps.position_semantics: route S's Position is a zero-based main-story paragraph position and route E's paragraph_text(i) index is a position in the full paragraph projection; they coincide at 0 on the two fixtures compared and the record claims nothing beyond that
known_gaps.selector: no perf-baseline selector opens a .doc through the facade, so nothing here moved a harness scenario; 0587 evidence gap 5 is unchanged

withheld: any registered claim, speedup, regression, cold-cache, physical-device, range-source, RSS, concurrency-scaling or cross-platform result

provenance.host: AMD EPYC 9R45, 32 cores, Linux 7.0.0-1012-aws, rustc 1.95.0, valgrind 3.26.0
